read: One authenticated order resource, current shared location balances, original warehouse movements/snapshots, native return events, immutable packing allocations, canonical manifest events and separate native carrier history.
stock: Absolute source snapshots anchor quantities once. Later observations and direct current source positions are compared with the append-linked ledger; unexplained differences remain discrepancies. A snapshot is never summed as another receipt.
shipment: A manifest acknowledgment or packing observation cannot prove carrier acceptance or deduct stock. Match the original native carrier event, canonical package/label/confirmation/allocation and exact negative warehouse movement per SKU/location. The warehouse movement reference_id is the original carrier acceptance event ID.
return: Every native event and disposition, including zero-stock effects, must link to the canonical request and a nonempty created native-return identity. Effective unit/grade must agree with canonical receipt history. Local disposition also requires its exact canonical command, unit claims, applied state, native ID and applied observation. A returned unit maps to the sorted original shipped order units explicitly linked to that return request or native return. Return-local ordinal is never silently equated with order ordinal. Corrections match the full unit/variant/location/delta adjustment identity; conflicting canonical mapping remains explicit.
partial: Requested quantities derive from the verified canonical selection even without a receiving session. A matched shipment with an unreceived requested return remains return_pending. A partial return may reconcile observed stock while preserving each unreceived requested unit as pending in partial_return_reconciled; financial settlement, full receipt and physical qualification are not implied.
repair: Import existing source return observations through WarehouseReturnEvents and existing snapshots/movements through LocationInventory. No source effect executor is called. Missing carrier imports use the separately authorized existing ShippingManifests.observe path; this service keeps their absence explicit.
authority: Current operation.read/resource.read and erasure guards for inspection. Repair additionally requires current operation.reconcile, warehouse.receive and event.process permissions, including existing recovery quarantine and source configuration checks.
privacy: Reports are computed per resource and not persisted in a new table. Caller copies require independent cleanup. Shared stock quantities retain minimized audit from other resources without returning their subject-linked history.
post_erasure_limit: If a source transfer commits with a lost response and the subject is erased before movement import, current erased-resource guards block automatic import and transfer reconciliation. Shared canonical stock may remain stale and block dependent transfers. Operator reconciliation under preserved privacy constraints is required; retain the original effect identity and never recreate the operation as a repair.
targeted_fault: Execute an isolated copy of the changed module that reports green despite an unexplained stock difference; the independent behavioral assertion must fail.
